title: SkMug
description: A Skript addon for basic PDC support. Adds support for all PDC types supplied by Bukkit/Paper
body: SkMug is a Skript addon that adds support for reading and writing Persistent Data Container (PDC) tags directly in Skript. It currently supports all primitive types: byte, short, integer, long, float, double, boolean, and string. On items, blocks, and other persistent data holders!
